ammonia.reason: Very young low proteolysis with minimal amino acid deamination to NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk and lactic starter with no Enterobacteriaceae/Brevibacterium p-cresol/indole.

bitter.reason: Short age and washed curd limit hydrophobic peptide accumulation from rennet/culture proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone methyl ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Good melt with residual lactose/galactose and lysine drives Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism to diacetyl/acetoin in young washed curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis to butanoic/hexanoic acids in 50-d pasteurized milk with low lipase activity.

creaminess.reason: 40% moisture and ~30.6% fat with washed low-acid casein matrix gives smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: High moisture elastic rennet gel with intact calcium-paracasein, not dried or long-aged.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard washed-curd at 40% moisture and pH 5.3 gives medium-firm elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in short-aged Jack.

fruity.reason: Early esterification to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate plus C6 aldehydes from added jalapeno/habanero peppers.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only with no caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched-chain fatty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines due to short age and no thermophilic Alpine cook.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 intact hydrated paracasein with washed-curd low calcium gives excellent flow without stretching.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No mold surface flora so no linoleic acid oxidation to 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: ~30% fat in young porous network releases moderate free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make with fresh jalapeno/habanero peppers, no wood-smoke guaiacol/syringol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactococcus-derived lactic acid at pH 5.3 plus minor acetic acid from peppers/starter.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd with no hot-water kneading, flows rather than strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Mild pasteurization/warm cook H2S and low methionine to methanethiol/methional in young cheese.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/lactate and diacetyl milky sweetness balanced by 1.8% salt.

umami.reason: Limited chymosin/plasmin proteolysis to glutamate peptides at 50 days age.
